'''Hkaeli''' was a trader with a connection to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Hkaeli posted a comment about the suitability of the [[S9-series heavy power droid]] for rugged [[Planet/Legends|planets]] such as [[Generis/Legends|Generis]] and [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and remarked that for this reason, the Rebel Alliance was trying to purchase or capture a number of the [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. The warning was included in the next version of [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]].
